ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Open to nondegree graduate and nondegree undergraduate students and NRES MS and AGED MS students. No class thanksgiving break week. This course will meet online every other Tuesday throughout the semester. The course will culminate in a field study trip to Sierra de Alamos in Southeastern Sonora, Mexico on January 4 to 15, 2010. This course requires a substantial fee (currently estimated at $1,500). For more information, contact Dr. Endress (244-1679 or via email at aendress@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
